== Template:Item/Categories ==

Auto-assigns categories based on item properties. Only applies in main namespace (not in template/sandbox pages).

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''item_type''' || Yes || Main item type: weapon, armor, charm, consumable, spellscroll, skillbook, aura, mold, general
|-
| '''weapon_type''' || For weapons || Slot type: Primary, Secondary, Primary or Secondary, Primary - 2-Handed
|-
| '''slot''' || For armor || Armor slot: Head, Neck, Ring, Hand, Chest, Arm, Bracer, Leg, Waist, Foot, Back, Charm
|-
| '''range''' || For ranged || Weapon range (>1 adds to Ranged Weapons category)
|-
| '''proc_style''' || For weapons/armor || Forwarded from {{tl|Item/Weapon}}/{{tl|Item/Armor}}. Used with '''proc_spell_name''' to classify spell-effect bucket: Activatable, Worn, Attack, Bash, Cast.
|-
| '''proc_spell_name''' || For weapons/armor || Presence gates the Worn/Proc buckets.
|-
| '''effect_style''' || For general items || Forwarded from {{tl|Item/General}}. Value "Activatable" places the item in [[:Category:Activatable Items]].
|-
| '''aura_spell_name''' || For auras || Presence places the item in [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]] (auras keep their existing [[:Category:Auras]] as the type bucket).
|}

=== Category Assignments ===

{| class="wikitable"
! item_type !! Categories Added
|-
| weapon || Weapons + slot-specific + ranged if applicable
|-
| armor || Armor + slot-specific
|-
| charm || Charms
|-
| consumable || Consumables
|-
| spellscroll || Ability Books, Spell Scrolls
|-
| skillbook || Ability Books, Skill Books
|-
| aura || Auras
|-
| mold || Molds
|-
| general || Items
|}

=== Spell-Effect Categories ===

In addition to the item-type categories above, items are also placed into spell-effect buckets based on how their attached spell is triggered. All buckets are subcategories of [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]].

{| class="wikitable"
! Bucket !! Category !! Trigger
|-
| Activatable || [[:Category:Activatable Items]] || Right-click or hotkey to trigger. Weapons/armor with '''proc_style=Activatable''' and general items with '''effect_style=Activatable'''. Consumables are intentionally excluded — they remain in [[:Category:Consumables]].
|-
| Proc || [[:Category:Proc Items]] || Triggers automatically in combat. Weapons with '''proc_style=Attack''' or '''Bash''', armor with '''proc_style=Cast''' (bracers). Requires '''proc_spell_name'''.
|-
| Worn Effect || [[:Category:Worn Effect Items]] || Passive effect while equipped. Weapons/armor with '''proc_style=Worn''' and a '''proc_spell_name'''.
|-
| Aura || [[:Category:Auras]] || Party-wide passive from the aura slot. Auras with an '''aura_spell_name'''. (Uses the existing Auras category; also appears under [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]].)
|}

=== Examples ===

==== 2-Handed Weapon ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Categories
|item_type=weapon
|weapon_type=Primary - 2-Handed
}}
</pre>

Adds: [[:Category:Weapons]], [[:Category:2-Handed Weapons]]

==== Weapon with an Activatable Proc ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Categories
|item_type=weapon
|weapon_type=Primary
|proc_style=Activatable
|proc_spell_name=Devour
}}
</pre>

Adds: [[:Category:Weapons]], [[:Category:Primary Weapons]], [[:Category:Activatable Items]], [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]]

==== Bracer with a Cast Proc ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Categories
|item_type=armor
|slot=Bracer
|proc_style=Cast
|proc_spell_name=Stun
}}
</pre>

Adds: [[:Category:Armor]], [[:Category:Bracer Armor]], [[:Category:Proc Items]], [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]]

==== Cape with a Worn Effect ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Categories
|item_type=armor
|slot=Back
|proc_style=Worn
|proc_spell_name=Vitheo's Blessing of the Wind
}}
</pre>

Adds: [[:Category:Armor]], [[:Category:Back Items]], [[:Category:Worn Effect Items]], [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]]

==== Consumable ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Categories
|item_type=consumable
}}
</pre>

Adds: [[:Category:Consumables]]. Consumables are deliberately kept out of the spell-effect taxonomy since the whole category is already activatable by definition.

==== Activatable General Item ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Categories
|item_type=general
|effect_style=Activatable
|effect_spell_name=Light of the Lantern
}}
</pre>

Adds: [[:Category:Items]], [[:Category:Activatable Items]], [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]]

==== Aura ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Categories
|item_type=aura
|aura_spell_name=Aura: The Prism
}}
</pre>

Adds: [[:Category:Auras]], [[:Category:Items with Spell Effects]]
